message.content:
Original oil paintings executed entirely by hand fall under heading 9701, which covers paintings, drawings and pastels executed entirely by hand. Within 9701.10 (paintings, drawings and pastels), the statistical suffix for an original oil painting is 9701.10.0000 in the HTSUS. Heading 9701 also has subheading 9701.10.00 with a statistical suffix split: 9701.10.0000 is "Paintings, drawings and pastels," with subdivisions 9701.10.0000 only. The framing does not change the classification, since under Note 2 to Chapter 97 frames are classified with the painting if they are of a kind and value normally appropriate to it.
